name: Tmc2209 → Stallguard
description: Change the StallGuard settings at runtime. See [Stall Detection](https://esphome.io/components/stepper/tmc2209/#stall-detection).

config_entries.label: Tcool Threshold
config_entries.description: The `TCOOLTHRS` value, `0` to `1048575`. StallGuard and CoolStep are active above the speed set by this value. A higher value means a lower speed. `0` disables both. See [Stall Detection](https://esphome.io/components/stepper/tmc2209/#stall-detection) for the conversion between this value and speed.

config_entries.label: Threshold
config_entries.description: The `SGTHRS` value, `0` to `255`. A stall is reported when the StallGuard result drops below twice this value, so a higher value detects a stall sooner.
